name: Verizon Home Phone (copper landline and Fios Digital Voice)
notes: Researched from public verizon.com residential support pages only (no sign-in). My Verizon sign-in asks for a User ID or Verizon mobile number, then Continue, then a password (or approving a notification sent to a verified text-capable phone, modelled as SMS verification). Online payments accept checking/savings, debit/credit card and online banking via Trustly; one-time payments can be made without full sign-in ('Make a one-time payment'). Auto Pay lets the customer pick a day of the month from a calendar (exact allowed days not published, family default kept) and accepts bank, debit, credit or Verizon Visa card; the Auto Pay discount ($10/month with eligible Fios Internet or TV, $20 with both) needs a bank account or Verizon Visa Card plus paper-free billing, and does not apply to home phone alone. Payment arrangements are free online or through the automated line, $7 Agent Assistance Fee with a representative; late payment charges still apply. Disconnecting Fios service online opens a chat with a representative from Settings & profile > Disconnect; other home services (DSL/copper) are disconnected through Customer Service at 1-800-837-4966. Same-day payments can be cancelled from payment history up to 2 times in 90 days.

help.title: How to pay your Verizon home bill
paragraphs: Sign in to My Verizon and go to Home, then Bills, then Pay bill. You can pay from a checking or savings account, a debit or credit card, or online banking through Trustly without typing account and routing numbers.

You can also schedule a one-time payment for a later date; it is taken on that date, so make sure funds are there. Same-day payments can be cancelled on the payment history page up to 2 times in any 90-day period.

Other ways to pay: call 800-837-4966, mail a check to the P.O. box for your state, pay in person at a payment location, or use Pay My Bill from the Fios TV menu. Verizon charges a fee for returned payments and a late fee when payment arrives late.

help.title: Fios Auto Pay
paragraphs: In My Verizon, open Bill, then Auto Pay, and choose Set Up Auto Pay. Pick a bank account, debit card, credit card or Verizon Visa Card, choose the day of the month from the calendar, review on Manage Auto Pay, select Enroll and accept the terms. Keep paying until the first automatic payment is taken.
The Auto Pay discount needs a bank account or Verizon Visa Card plus paper-free billing: $10 a month with an eligible Fios Internet or Fios TV plan, $20 with both.
To turn Auto Pay off or change it, go to Bill, then Auto Pay, and follow the prompts. If you disconnect, Auto Pay stays on until outstanding charges are paid.
steps: Go to Bill, then Auto Pay.
Choose a payment method and a payment day.
Select Enroll and accept the terms.

help.title: Paper-free billing
paragraphs: Sign in to My Verizon, open the Paper-free billing settings and select Enroll. Your first and last bills still come on paper.
To go back to paper, select De-enroll on the same page. If your plan requires paper-free billing, you have to change plans first.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: A payment arrangement is a plan to pay your past-due balance by a future date, and you can split the past-due amount into 2 payments. Set it up in My Verizon from the payment arrangement page, where you can also schedule the withdrawals.

Arrangements made online or through the automated phone system are free. A $7 Agent Assistance Fee applies when a representative makes, changes or cancels the arrangement by phone. An arrangement does not stop late payment charges.

help.title: Disconnect your home service
paragraphs: Fios services can be disconnected online: in My Verizon open Settings & profile, select Disconnect, start a chat, type disconnect and ask for a representative. You can also call 1-800-VERIZON (800-837-4966), Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM ET and Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM ET.

If you are under contract an early termination fee of up to $350 may apply, dropping $15 each month. Return rented equipment within 30 days to avoid an unreturned equipment charge. A remaining credit can take up to 60 days to come back.

solution.text: A $7 Agent Assistance Fee applies; online or automated arrangements are free.
